About the Role

Responsible for administering, configuring, and continuously improving the ServiceNow platform to support HR and IT service delivery. This role involves gathering and analyzing business requirements across functions and translating them into effective application solutions, integrations, and process improvements. The consultant will provide functional and technical support across enterprise applications, ensuring system reliability and performance, and contribute to application enhancements, testing, reporting, documentation, and the delivery of efficient, secure, and business-aligned technology solutions.

Responsibilities

• Administer the ServiceNow platform day to day — including managing users, groups, roles, ACLs, notifications, scheduled jobs, MID Servers, and instance health — and keep it current through family upgrades, patching, and instance clones.

• Configure and extend ServiceNow using Flow Designer, Business Rules, Client Scripts, UI Policies, Script Includes, and Service Catalog items; manage update sets and controlled promotion from sub-production to production.

• Administer and enhance ServiceNow HR Service Delivery — including HR case management, lifecycle events, Employee Center, knowledge bases, and employee document management — working directly with the HR function.

Requirements

• Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, Software Engineering or a related discipline.

• ServiceNow Certified System Administrator (CSA) — required or to be obtained within the first six months.

• Preferred: CIS–HR (HR Service Delivery), CIS–ITSM, Certified Application Developer (CAD).

Squadio is a Global Remote-first IT service provider headquartered in Riyadh KSA with Delivery Centers in Egypt and KSA. Our distributed teams are located in Tunisia, Egypt, KSA, Palestine, Nigeria & India. We were founded in 2011 in Riyadh, KSA, as an app development company (previously Ibtikar technologies) successfully pivoted our model to support the growing need of startups and companies seeking to hire and manage their own engineering team remotely with engineers vetted by Squadio’s talent community.

We are looking for a great Senior Java Web Developer who is proficient with JEE/Java Web Development with strong experience in JSF.

jobs.job_title: Platform Development Engineer – Agile Sprint Team | Riyadh, Saudi Arabia
jobs.job_description:
Location

Riyadh, Saudi Arabia

Job Category

Information Technology (IT) & Software
Engineering & Technical

Job Overview

A technology organization is seeking experienced software and platform development professionals to join its Platform Development Sprint Team in Riyadh, Saudi Arabia. The role supports monthly development sprints and the continuous enhancement of digital platforms and production systems, with a strong focus on delivering reliable, production-ready solutions within defined timelines.

The successful candidate will work in an Agile/Scrum environment and contribute across the software development lifecycle, including development, testing, deployment, and release activities. Strong knowledge of APIs, system integrations, technical troubleshooting, and production application support is required.

This opportunity is suitable for professionals seeking career growth in software and platform development, Agile delivery, system integration, DevOps, and digital platform engineering. Experience with REST APIs, databases, CI/CD pipelines, cloud environments, and modern DevOps practices can further support professional development.

Key Responsibilities

• Develop and deliver production-ready software and platform solutions.

• Participate in monthly Agile/Scrum development sprints.

• Work effectively within defined sprint timelines and delivery objectives.

• Develop and support APIs and system integrations.

• Diagnose and resolve integration issues and application defects.

• Troubleshoot platform performance and production system problems.

• Participate in software development lifecycle activities.

• Support software testing, deployment, and release processes.

• Work with REST APIs, web services, databases, and integration technologies.

• Collaborate with technical, product, and business teams to deliver platform improvements.

• Support continuous enhancement of digital platforms and production systems.

• Apply appropriate quality and reliability standards throughout development and deployment.

• Contribute to technical troubleshooting and problem-solving activities.

• Support DevOps, CI/CD, and cloud-related activities where applicable.

Requirements & Qualifications

• Strong professional experience in software and/or platform development.

• Hands-on experience working in Agile/Scrum environments.

• Experience delivering software development sprints.

• Strong knowledge of APIs and system integrations.

• Proven ability to develop and deliver production-ready solutions.

• Good understanding of the Software Development Lifecycle (SDLC).

• Experience with software testing, deployment, and release processes.

• Experience diagnosing integration issues and application defects.

• Ability to troubleshoot platform performance and production system problems.

• Familiarity with REST APIs and web services is preferred.

• Familiarity with databases and integration technologies is preferred.

• Knowledge of Git is an advantage.

• Knowledge of CI/CD pipelines and DevOps practices is an advantage.

• Experience with cloud environments is an advantage.

• Strong analytical and problem-solving capabilities.

• Excellent collaboration and communication skills.

• Ability to work effectively across technical, product, and business teams.

• Ability to maintain quality and reliability while working within sprint deadlines.

Salary, Benefits & Career Growth

Salary and specific compensation details have not been provided.

This role offers professional development opportunities across platform engineering, Agile/Scrum delivery, API development, system integration, SDLC, testing, deployment, DevOps, CI/CD, and cloud technologies. Continued technical training and relevant professional certifications can support long-term career growth in software and platform development.

About the role

The company Studio is a Saudi AI application designed to transform plain-language business descriptions into functional business systems, such as HR platforms, online stores, and sales boards. Our team in Riyadh is dedicated to enhancing business operations across the Kingdom and beyond.

What you will do

• Design screens and workflows for the company Studio application across iPhone, Android, and web platforms.

• Create templates for business systems developed within the company Studio, accommodating both Arabic (right to left) and English languages.

• Conduct user testing on designs and implement improvements based on feedback.

• Maintain the design system, ensuring colors, typography, and components are in sync with development needs.

• Review designs prior to each release to ensure quality and functionality.

What we need

• A bachelor’s degree or equivalent work experience is required.

• Must be based in Riyadh or willing to relocate.

• A minimum of 3 years of experience in designing mobile and web applications; a portfolio showcasing past work is required.

• Proficiency in Figma and familiarity with designing right-to-left Arabic interfaces.

• Fluency in both Arabic and English, written and spoken.

Pay and terms

• Monthly salary ranges from SAR 14,000 to 20,000 (inclusive of basic salary and allowances), commensurate with experience.

• Full-time position, on-site in our Riyadh office; working hours and annual leave follow Saudi Labour Law regulations.

• Health insurance and GOSI registration provided, in accordance with Saudi law.

How we select

• Applications will receive responses within 7 days.

• Initial 30-minute video call to introduce you to the company Studio.

• For shortlisted candidates, a design exercise lasting 30 minutes will be conducted using the company Studio on our test account (no personal accounts needed).

• Final interview in Riyadh with all candidates informed of their interview results within 30 days.

Applications

Applications are accepted online only through this job posting until 14 January 2027. Each application is evaluated based on skills and experience, and adjustments for candidates with disabilities are available upon request.
